sections.name: Check-in
sections.asr_prompt: Personal check-in. Mood, energy, workload, work-life balance, time off, general wellbeing.
sections.synthesis_prompt: Two or three sentences capturing how the person is doing overall.

sections.name: Wins since last time
sections.asr_prompt: Recent wins and highlights. Shipped, delivered, closed, launched, milestone reached, positive feedback, kudos.
sections.synthesis_prompt: Short bullet list of concrete wins, most impactful first.

sections.name: Challenges and blockers
sections.asr_prompt: Challenges and blockers. Blocked by, waiting on, dependency, unclear priorities, capacity, tooling issues, cross-team friction.
sections.synthesis_prompt: One bullet per challenge: the problem, its impact, and what help is needed.

sections.name: Feedback
sections.asr_prompt: Feedback in both directions. Manager feedback, peer feedback, what to keep doing, what to change, expectations.
sections.synthesis_prompt: Separate 'feedback given' and 'feedback received', each as brief bullets.

sections.name: Growth and development
sections.asr_prompt: Growth and career development. Goals, skills, training, mentoring, promotion, new responsibilities, stretch project.
sections.synthesis_prompt: Summarise development goals and any agreed steps towards them.

sections.name: Action items
sections.asr_prompt: Action items. Assignee, task, due date, follow up next one-on-one, check back on.
sections.synthesis_prompt: One bullet per action item in the form 'Owner: task — due date'.
